summary: Converts units and calculates dates, as tools a language model calls.

options.title: Decimal places
options.help: The decimal places a converted value is rounded to.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Converts a measurement from one unit to another of the same kind: length (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi), mass (mg, g, kg, oz, lb), volume (ml, l, cup, qt, gal), or temperature (C, F, K). Returns the converted value and its unit.

from.description: The unit the value is in, such as "km" or "F".

to.description: The unit to convert to, of the same kind as from.

tools.name: calculate_date
tools.description: Calculates with calendar dates in the Gregorian calendar. "add-days" adds a number of days to a date, negative to go back, and returns the new date and its weekday. "days-between" returns the days from one date to another, negative when the second is earlier. Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: For add-days: the days to add.

otherDate.description: For days-between: the second date, YYYY-MM-DD.
